notes: Crafting recipes replaced with the selected 76 recipe entries for Smelting, Wildcraft, Food, Refining, and Cloth. Recipe variants preserve profession level, batch output, gold cost, and ingredients. Existing material source notes and gathering-tool recipes are retained. Recipe entries now distinguish actual profession level from display tier.

iron-ore.name: Iron Ore
iron-ore.location: Dark Veins in Diamond Shores, Gylden Ruins, and Astron Plains
iron-ore.sourceDetails: Mine Dark Veins with a Pickaxe. The gathering guide lists 432 veins; most are in Diamond Shores.
iron-ore.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

sweetgrass-powder.name: Sweetgrass Powder
sweetgrass-powder.location: Sold by Avon at Seaglass Harbor and by general merchants elsewhere
sweetgrass-powder.sourceDetails: Purchase from Avon (Seaglass Harbor) or another General Merchant. The tavern-specific seller was not confirmed by the database.
sweetgrass-powder.sourceStatus: Vendor and Seaglass Harbor location verified; tavern placement not confirmed.

shattered-blade.name: Shattered Blade
shattered-blade.location: Enemy drops; early sources include Jeco and Pirates; Corpse Warblade at Phlegthon Lake
shattered-blade.sourceDetails: The item database lists hundreds of enemy sources. Jeco and Pirates are documented early-game sources; Corpse Warblade is listed at Phlegthon Lake.
shattered-blade.sourceStatus: Enemy sources verified; best farming route not established.

log.name: Log
log.location: Young and Mature Trees throughout Auroria
log.sourceDetails: Gather from Young or Mature Trees with a Logging Axe; nodes are spread across regions.
log.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

rag-scrap.name: Rag Scrap
rag-scrap.location: Enemy drops; Jeco and Pirates are early sources; Corpse Warblade at Phlegthon Lake
rag-scrap.sourceDetails: The item database lists hundreds of enemy sources. Jeco and Pirates are documented early-game sources; Corpse Warblade is listed at Phlegthon Lake.
rag-scrap.sourceStatus: Enemy sources verified; best farming route not established.

wild-petal.name: Wild Petal
wild-petal.location: Lily nodes across the regions; a special flower chest at Cemetery, Gylden Ruins
wild-petal.sourceDetails: Gather from Lily with a Sickle. A separate Cemetery chest is listed in Gylden Ruins and requires a Yellow Flower.
wild-petal.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

bone-chip.name: Bone Chip
bone-chip.location: Butcher crocodiles or alligator turtles along the Diamond Shores coast
bone-chip.sourceDetails: Use a Hunting Knife after hunting crocodiles or alligator turtles. The Gathering Bone Fragments quest identifies the shoreline route; Gylden Ruins also has reptiles.
bone-chip.sourceStatus: Verified route; some databases also list additional enemy drops.

archeum-shard.name: Archeum Shard
archeum-shard.location: Archeum veins in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Diamond Shores
archeum-shard.sourceDetails: Mine Archeum nodes with a Pickaxe. Most listed nodes are in Gylden Ruins; a few chests and exploration finds also contain shards.
archeum-shard.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

twisted-scale.name: Twisted Scale
twisted-scale.location: Dreadbreath enemies at Serpens' Domain and nearby Astron Plains sites
twisted-scale.sourceDetails: Dreadbreath Champion and Warrior variants drop Twisted Scale; the item database lists Serpens' Domain, Human Trafficking Site, and Central Wetlands.

lingering-soul-fragment.name: Lingering Soul Fragment
lingering-soul-fragment.location: Dropped by Wraith Infantrymen, Wraith Archers, and other undead
lingering-soul-fragment.sourceDetails: Multiple undead types drop it across regions. The item database lists 30% drops from several Wraith enemies; consult the linked page for the full list.
lingering-soul-fragment.sourceStatus: Verified enemy sources; no single best route established.

wolf-molar.name: Wolf Molar
wolf-molar.location: Butcher wolves; Fierce Wolves in Ferrous Ravine are a 100% source
wolf-molar.sourceDetails: Use a Hunting Knife. Other wolf sources span Diamond Shores, Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Reedwind Cave.
wolf-molar.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

crystalline-ore.name: Crystalline Ore
crystalline-ore.location: Amethyst Veins in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Diamond Shores
crystalline-ore.sourceDetails: Mine Amethyst Veins with a Pickaxe. It can also drop from Hereafter bosses.
crystalline-ore.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

high-quality-iron-ore.name: High-Quality Iron Ore
high-quality-iron-ore.location: Dark Veins in Diamond Shores, Gylden Ruins, and Astron Plains (rare)
high-quality-iron-ore.sourceDetails: High-Quality Iron Ore is a 1% Dark Vein yield. Dark Veins are most numerous in Diamond Shores.
high-quality-iron-ore.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

marble.name: Marble
marble.location: Rock nodes in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Diamond Shores
marble.sourceDetails: Mine Rock nodes with a Pickaxe. The current listing shows the largest number in Gylden Ruins.
marble.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

white-marble.name: White Marble
white-marble.location: Rock nodes in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Diamond Shores (rare)
white-marble.sourceDetails: White Marble is a 1% Rock yield. Mine Rock nodes with a Pickaxe.
white-marble.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

fragrant-wild-petal.name: Fragrant Wild Petal
fragrant-wild-petal.location: Lily nodes across Diamond Shores, Gylden Ruins, and Astron Plains (rare)
fragrant-wild-petal.sourceDetails: Fragrant Wild Petal is a rare Lily yield; the gathering database lists 3,691 Lily markers across the three regions.
fragrant-wild-petal.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

bear-gallbladder.name: Bear Gallbladder
bear-gallbladder.location: Great Wild Bear near Seaglass Workshop (Diamond Shores); Bloodsoaked Sloth at Gloam Ruins
bear-gallbladder.sourceDetails: Both are listed 100% drops. It is also available from other bosses and a treasure chest.
bear-gallbladder.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

bellflower-dewdrop.name: Evening Dewdrop
bellflower-dewdrop.location: Evening Dew Bellflowers and rare exploration finds; current item name is Evening Dewdrop
bellflower-dewdrop.sourceDetails: The current Early Access item name is Evening Dewdrop (formerly Bellflower Dewdrop). The tracker lists six Evening Dew Bellflower chest markers and additional boss drops.
bellflower-dewdrop.sourceStatus: Verified name update; sources include exploration finds and enemy drops.

hardened-logs.name: Hardened Logs
hardened-logs.location: Young and Mature Trees throughout Auroria (rare)
hardened-logs.sourceDetails: Hardened Logs are a 1% yield from Young and Mature Trees; gather with a Logging Axe.
hardened-logs.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

buffalo-horn.name: Buffalo Horn
buffalo-horn.location: Buffalo and bison; Field Buffalo in Carnas Forest (Diamond Shores) and Foggy Highlands Buffalo in Mistwind Plateau
buffalo-horn.sourceDetails: Buffalo Horn is a 30% drop from several buffalo variants. Butchering is not required for the horn.
buffalo-horn.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

blushpetal-branch.name: Blushpetal Branch
blushpetal-branch.location: Rare flora, treasure chests, and Hereafter boss drops
blushpetal-branch.sourceDetails: The item database lists 15 Hereafter bosses plus chest sources. Exact rare-flora marker locations vary by map listing.
blushpetal-branch.sourceStatus: Verified acquisition sources; no single best gathering spot established.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.location: Grow in a Small Garden or Scarecrow Garden; chest at Bluesalt Farm, Diamond Shores
pumpkin.sourceDetails: Harvest from a garden. A chest at Bluesalt Farm is also listed.

cabbage.name: Cabbage
cabbage.location: Grow in a Small Garden; chest in Gylden Ruins
cabbage.sourceDetails: Harvest from a garden; the item database lists a Gylden Ruins chest source.

carrot.name: Carrot
carrot.location: Grow from a seedling; Carrot Seedling chest at Silent Crossway, Diamond Shores
carrot.sourceDetails: Carrot is a garden crop. The seedling can also be found in a Silent Crossway chest or from Wild Bushes.

corn.name: Corn
corn.location: Grow from a Corn Seedling in a garden
corn.sourceDetails: Corn is a cultivated crop. Use a garden; seedling supply depends on merchant and wild-bush sources.
corn.sourceStatus: Farming source verified; exact seedling map source not fully confirmed.

barley.name: Barley
barley.location: Grow in a Small Garden; Hiller sells Barley Seedlings at Seaglass Harbor Residences
barley.sourceDetails: Barley Seedlings can also be found from Wild Bushes and a quest reward.

wheat.name: Wheat
wheat.location: Grow in a garden; Wheat Seedling chest at Bluesalt Farm, Diamond Shores
wheat.sourceDetails: Wheat is harvested from a cultivated seedling. The seedling page lists Bluesalt Farm chest and Small Garden sources.

crab.name: Crab
crab.sourceDetails: The current database identifies Suspicious Rock as Crab’s gathering node (522 markers). Specific region counts were not consistently available across trackers.
crab.sourceStatus: Gathering node verified; exact zone breakdown not confirmed.

clam.name: Clam
clam.location: Coastal Clam gathering nodes; Diamond Shores is confirmed
clam.sourceDetails: One tracker lists three Diamond Shores spots; another current database lists additional Clam markers in other zones, so its full map count varies.
clam.sourceStatus: Gathering source verified; total map locations differ between trackers.

watermelon.name: Watermelon
watermelon.location: Grow in a Small Garden; chest in Gylden Ruins
watermelon.sourceDetails: The item page lists garden harvests and one Gylden Ruins chest.

melon.name: Melon
melon.sourceDetails: The item is a cultivated crop; I could not confirm a fixed chest or gathering-node location.
melon.sourceStatus: Farming source verified; exact seedling/map source not confirmed.

raw-meat.name: Raw Meat
raw-meat.location: Butcher bison in Diamond Shores or mountain goats in Astron Plains and Gylden Ruins
raw-meat.sourceDetails: Mudflat Bison and Field Buffalo in Diamond Shores, and Mountain Goats around Astron Plains/Gylden Ruins, are documented sources.
raw-meat.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

sweet-potato.name: Sweet Potato
sweet-potato.location: Grow in a garden; Hiller sells Sweet Potato Seedlings at Seaglass Harbor Residences
sweet-potato.sourceDetails: Seedlings are also listed from Wild Bushes.

potato.name: Potato
potato.location: Grow in a Small or Scarecrow Garden; chest in Gylden Ruins
potato.sourceDetails: The item page lists garden harvests and one Gylden Ruins chest.

thunderstruck-shell.name: Thunderstruck Shell
thunderstruck-shell.location: Harvest Thunderstruck Crop in a Small Garden; buy from Didie (Astron Plains) or Kaimder (Gylden Ruins)
thunderstruck-shell.sourceDetails: The item page lists garden harvests and token purchases from Didie and Kaimder; both vendors have a limit of one.

corrupted-heart.name: Corrupted Heart
corrupted-heart.location: Field boss drops; Great Wild Bear near Seaglass Workshop and Bloodsoaked Sloth at Gloam Ruins
corrupted-heart.sourceDetails: Many field bosses drop Corrupted Heart. These two early boss sources are listed at 100%.
corrupted-heart.sourceStatus: Verified from item and boss data.

orc-fang.name: Orc Fang
orc-fang.location: Ironhammer/Gorehammer orcs; Fierce Ironhammer Shaman near Seaglass Workshop
orc-fang.sourceDetails: The item page lists drops from Ironhammer and Gorehammer enemy types in several regions.
orc-fang.sourceStatus: Enemy sources verified; this is not a single guaranteed route.

magic-archeum-shard.name: Magic Archeum Shard
magic-archeum-shard.location: Archeum veins in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Diamond Shores (1% rare yield)
magic-archeum-shard.sourceDetails: Mine Archeum with a Pickaxe; Magic Archeum Shard is listed at a 1% yield.
magic-archeum-shard.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

turtle-shell-fragment.name: Turtle Shell Fragment
turtle-shell-fragment.location: Butcher Coastal Alligator Turtles at Seaglass Beach (Diamond Shores); Giant Alligator Turtle at Lost Fishing Village
turtle-shell-fragment.sourceDetails: Coastal Alligator Turtle has a 30% butchering yield; Giant Alligator Turtle is listed as a guaranteed drop.
turtle-shell-fragment.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

star-fragment.name: Star Fragment
star-fragment.location: Star Meteor nodes in Gylden Ruins, Astron Plains, and Leopard Battalion Camp (Diamond Shores)
star-fragment.sourceDetails: The item page lists Star Meteor gathering and chests; Hereafter bosses also drop it.
star-fragment.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

crude-gnoll-fur.name: Crude Gnoll Fur
crude-gnoll-fur.location: Gnoll enemies; Fierce Gnoll Fighter near Jubilant Village
crude-gnoll-fur.sourceDetails: Gnoll enemy drops are listed at 30%; other sources span several regions.
crude-gnoll-fur.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

raw-pelt.name: Raw Pelt
raw-pelt.location: Butcher wolves and bears; Fierce Wolves in Ferrous Ravine are a 100% source
raw-pelt.sourceDetails: Use a Hunting Knife. Other predators across multiple regions also yield Raw Pelt.
raw-pelt.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

crocodile-hide.name: Crocodile Hide
crocodile-hide.location: Butcher Fierce Crocodiles and Coastal Alligators along Diamond Shores
crocodile-hide.sourceDetails: Fierce Crocodile in Diamond Shores is a 100% source; Coastal Alligators also yield it.
crocodile-hide.sourceStatus: Verified from item and enemy data.

wild-fiber.name: Wild Fiber
wild-fiber.location: Wildfiber Herb and Wildfiber Bloom in Gylden Ruins, Diamond Shores, and Astron Plains
wild-fiber.sourceDetails: Gather with a Sickle. The database lists 620 Wildfiber Herbs and 389 Wildfiber Blooms across these regions.
wild-fiber.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

tough-wild-fiber.name: Tough Wild Fiber
tough-wild-fiber.location: Rare yield from Wildfiber Herbs and Blooms in Gylden Ruins, Diamond Shores, and Astron Plains
tough-wild-fiber.sourceDetails: Gather with a Sickle; tough fiber is a rare yield from both wildfiber node types.
tough-wild-fiber.sourceStatus: Verified from item and gathering-node data.

mountain-goat-wool.name: Mountain Goat Wool
mountain-goat-wool.location: Butcher Mountain Goats in Gylden Ruins and Astron Plains (30% yield)
mountain-goat-wool.sourceDetails: Mountain Goats and Ravenous Mountain Goats yield Mountain Goat Wool when butchered.
mountain-goat-wool.sourceStatus: Verified from enemy and butchering data.
